family.description: This domain is found at the C-terminal end of the probable enoyl -CoA hydratase alpha subunit from Thermomonospora curvata (ChsH2) and similar archaeal and bacterial proteins. ChsH2 is likely to be involved in bile acid degradation. The C-terminal region of this protein is organised into two domains: an N-terminal zinc finger domain ([pfam:PF12172]) and an OB-fold domain (this entry) that consists of a five-stranded beta-barrel [[cite:PUB00155451]]. This domain is also found in 3-oxo-4,17- pregnadiene-20-carboxyl-CoA hydratase alpha subunit from Mycobacterium tuberculosis that is involved in cholesterol side chain degradation [[cite:PUB00154876]]. It is also found in Methanothermococcus thermolithotrophicus HMGCS, an enzyme complex comprising the thiolase and 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl (HMG)-CoA synthase, that catalyses the second reaction in the mevalonate pathway-the exergonic condensation of acetoacetyl-CoA and acetyl-CoA to HMG-CoA [[cite:PUB00154878]].
family.name: ChsH2, C-terminal OB-fold domain

history.description: Inspected Gilbert 2018 kinetic evidence and Figure 5, plus Aggett 2019 mixing experiment and methods. Resolved H37Rv I6YGF8 and T. curvata D1AB77 mappings, retaining two direct observed edges. Construct, readout, residual activity and isolated-domain limits remain explicit; the T. curvata experiment is shared with PF12172, while the M. tuberculosis experiment is excluded from that family.

causal_graphs.context: 2.5-30 uM 17-HOPC-CoA in a preparation containing 3-OPDC-CoA; 100 mM sodium HEPES pH 7.5, 16 uM TTHB247, 200 uM NADH, 25 C, 1 mL, 5-15 minute kinetic assays.

evidence.explanation: Results, Figure 5 image and kinetic methods support the complex reaction, not a reaction catalyzed by DUF35 alone.
evidence.snippet: The purified Ltp2-DUF35 complex also possessed aldolase activity

evidence.explanation: The paper's Rv3542c locus maps to the reference and OB-fold interval; no current PF12172 match is present in the complete response.

edges.mechanism: The copurified complex cleaves the steroid side chain; propionyl-CoA formation is measured through TTHB247-coupled NADH oxidation, with substrate-dependent kinetics.
edges.subject: mtb-ltp2-duf35-system

causal_graphs.family_mapping: ChsH2/Rv3542c is I6YGF8, sequence version 1, 311 residues; PF01796 spans 234-295. The paper identifies the C-terminal construct as DUF35/PF01796; exact truncation boundaries remain unverified.
causal_graphs.limitations: The coupled NADH readout reports propionyl-CoA formation; direct product MS used a different, larger complex. DUF35 alone is inactive, while Ltp2 alone retains low activity with possible folding/stability limitations. No isolated-OB-fold catalysis, PF12172 assignment or virulence effect is inferred.
causal_graphs.scope: Copurified H37Rv His-tagged Ltp2 with the untagged ChsH2 C-terminal DUF35 construct, expressed in Rhodococcus jostii RHA1.
causal_graphs.title: M. tuberculosis Ltp2-DUF35 aldolase activity

causal_graphs.context: Ten-minute incubation at Ltp2:DUF35 ratio 1:5; activity toward 21 uM 17-HOPC-CoA measured at 25 C in 100 mM HEPES pH 7.5 with 200 uM NADH and 16 uM TTHB247.

evidence.explanation: The Results mixing experiment and kinetic methods establish increased activity, while residual Ltp2 activity rules out an absolute-requirement claim.
evidence.snippet: After a 10-min incubation of a 1:5 ratio of Ltp2/ChsH2

evidence.explanation: Current coordinates and the deposited construct establish inclusion of the OB fold; neither mapped domain was tested separately.

edges.mechanism: Mixing the purified partner construct with Ltp2 raises measured specific activity from about 0.00042 to 0.14 umol/min/mg in the coupled assay; this is a measured biochemical effect, not proof of an allosteric molecular mechanism.
edges.subject: tc-duf35-addition

causal_graphs.family_mapping: D1AB77, sequence version 1, 319 residues; PF01796 spans 237-298. Deposited 6OK1 entity 2 is initiator M plus reference 188-319 and includes PF12172 at 199-234.
causal_graphs.limitations: The tested construct includes both domains; their individual contributions are unresolved. Ltp2 alone retains weak activity and DUF35 alone is inactive. The same experiment is retained in PF12172, not independent replication. Allostery, folding assistance and bile-acid physiology are not established by this assay.
